chunks: Abu Ahmad Muhammad ibn Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Bandar at Forqanah narrated that Abul Abbas Muhammad ibn Jomhoor al-Hammadi said: Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Mansoor al-Balkhi at Mecca narrated that Yunus ibn Muhammad ibn Yazid ibn Abdullah al-Jumahi narrated that Abdul Salam ibn Salih al-Harawi, from Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha (peace be upon him), from his father Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), from his father Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him), from his father Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him), from his father Ali ibn al-Hussein (peace be upon him), from his father al-Hussein ibn Ali (peace be upon him), from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Faith is recognition by the heart, expression by the tongue, and action by the limbs.
ai.seo_question: What are the three components of faith according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this hadith presents the classic Shia definition of Iman as a triad of heart, tongue, and limbs, emphasizing that true belief necessitates both internal conviction and external manifestation. This formulation aligns with the Shia doctrine of 'action as a condition of perfection' rather than a prerequisite for the existence of faith, distinguishing it from the Khawarij view. The chain of transmission highlights the continuous link between the Prophet and the Imams, reinforcing the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt in defining creedal matters.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 22-2 Abu Ahmad Muhammad ibn Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Bondar at Forqanah narrated that Abul Abbas Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn Jomhoor al-Hammadi quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Mansoor al-Balkhi at Mecca, on the authority of Abu Yunus Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yazid ibn Abdullah al-Jomahy, on the authority of Abdul Salam ibn Salih al-Harawi, on the authority of Ali ibn Musa Al-Ridha (s), on the authority of his father Musa ibn Ja’far (s), on the authority of his father Ja’far ibn Muhammad (s), on the authority of his father Muhammad ibn Ali (s), on the authority of Ali ibn Al-Hussein (s), on the authority of his father Al-Hussein ibn Ali (s), on the authority of his father Ali ibn Abi Talib (s) that God’s Prophet (s) said, “
Faith is recognition by the heart, expression by the tongue and enacting by the body parts.”
